capabilities: Save new attachments in a folder named after the current note
Create the note-named folder when needed
Add a selectable default attachment location in Obsidian's settings
Fall back to Obsidian's normal attachment location when no Markdown note is active
disambiguation: Not a bulk file renamer; it only changes where new attachments are saved.
extras: While enabled, this location takes precedence over Obsidian's standard attachment-folder settings; existing files are not moved.
intentEvidence: In a folder named after the current note under Settings → Files & links → Default location for new attachments
problem: Obsidian's standard attachment-folder settings do not group new attachments by the note they belong to.
summary: Attachment location option that saves new files in a sibling folder named after the current note.
